results.critique: The first viewport plainly identifies the role as Technical Project Manager - Product Operations & Implementation and states the value proposition: turning emerging work into usable systems. The selected-work section then supplies credible, calibrated proof: leadership across web, e-commerce, analytics, content, marketing, and operations that contributed to 2x revenue growth, plus co-development of a successful $490,539 public-funding request and service as the City's named developer and presenter. Those formulations avoid claiming solo causality or governmental authority. A rushed hiring reader can cite both outcomes and follow the clearly labeled Read case study links, View all work, or the Technical Operations navigation item as relevant next actions.

The hierarchy is understandable and controlled: Jamie Burkart, the role line, and I help emerging work become usable systems establish identity and capability immediately. The header uses familiar destinations - Work, Technical Operations, About, Resume, and Contact. A single START HERE / Quick path through block governs initial orientation before the page moves into clearly subordinate SELECTED SYSTEMS proof. Project rows consistently pair a named system category and date with a concrete project, outcome, scope, and Read case study link. View all work expands the selected-work category, while See how the coalition system worked signals a useful explanatory destination rather than an unexplained action. No visible link or category forces the reader to invent the hierarchy.

The hero has clear visual authority: the East River portrait, bridge geometry, large serif name, condensed role line, and blunt white value statement form an authored, memorable composition rather than a generic portfolio banner. Desktop preserves strong subject-text balance; mobile makes an effective editorial crop, retaining the bridge, face, headline, and caption without a contrast failure. The project imagery also has useful variety: a dense storefront interface contrasts with the documentary field-work photograph, while consistent proportions keep both rows legible. Although the modules repeat, the materially different images, project classifications, evidence-led descriptions, and captions keep the accomplishments from reading as an undifferentiated feed.

The visible sequence is editorially coherent: the hero establishes identity and a concise thesis; START HERE signals orientation; the coalition material supplies civic proof; and SELECTED SYSTEMS opens representative work. Each visible project adds a distinct consequence rather than merely restating the thesis: Harry J. Epstein Company connects operations work to 2x revenue growth, while KC Town Hall LLC connects implementation to a $490,539 public-funding award and responsible transition. Proportion is deliberate: the hero receives dominant space, while representative projects receive substantial image-and-text rows with concrete outcomes. The repeated Harry J. Epstein material across the last two screenshots is viewport overlap, not a repeated homepage module. The central thesis is not repeatedly summarized.
